entries.zh-TW: 先寫軍令：選一張 doctrine 卡配給麾下小隊——令出自動行。
entries.en: Write your first order: assign a doctrine card to a squad — it executes itself.

entries.zh-TW: 部署：把小隊放上橋頭陣地，旗語已定。
entries.en: Deploy: place your squad on the bridgehead; the banners are set.

entries.zh-TW: 觀敵：看 doctrine 依條件自行觸發——見敵即擊，不待中軍。
entries.en: Observe: watch the doctrine trigger on its own condition — attack on sight, no orders needed.

entries.zh-TW: 干預：按一次 CP 強令凌駕 doctrine——將在外，君命亦可至。
entries.en: Intervene: spend CP once to override doctrine — the general's hand still reaches the field.

entries.zh-TW: 教學畢。此後各章節皆依此法——軍令狀自己寫。
entries.en: Tutorial complete. Every chapter hence works the same — write your own standing orders.
